correspondences.notes: No BIDS counterpart for an AFQ MATLAB structure.

brainlife.desc: Output structure of MATLAB AFQ_run (afq.mat): AFQ tract segmentation and along-tract profiles. No current Apps produce or use it.
brainlife.name: neuro/AFQ
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Archival AFQ results for MATLAB AFQ analysis.

**Not for:** Current brainlife pipelines; use wmc and tractmeasures instead. Owner review: confirm whether this datatype is still needed.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.AFQ.json

files.desc: MATLAB afq structure saved by AFQ_run.

identifying_risks: Rows keyed by subject and session codes
Values from rare conditions in small samples can single people out
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level derived measures without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Use coded subject IDs and drop dates
Release group summaries when per-participant rows are not needed
tier_conditions: Tier 1 once reduced to group statistics with no participant rows
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states

intended_use: Archival AFQ results for MATLAB AFQ analysis.
not_suitable_for: Current brainlife pipelines; use wmc and tractmeasures instead.
Owner review: confirm whether this datatype is still needed.
